description:
Software Engineer 

 About the Team: 

 The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems, particularly in the areas of airborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing.  Within this role, we perform work on full system prototypes, experiment campaigns and technology component development.  Development roles within the Sensors Division include RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, tracking/fusion, as well as real-time embedded processor implementation.

 Within the Sensors Division, the Maritime Domain Applications (MDA) Group focuses on development of advanced sensing concepts utilizing adaptive signal processing, resource management, advanced algorithm development, as well as executing advanced sensor concept demonstrations.

 The Role: 

 The MDA Group is seeking a Software Engineer to join a team supporting a critical ongoing national security mission. Our work spans the development of new algorithms and sensing concepts through their implementation in efficient software for real-world systems.

 The Software Engineer will work as part of MDA’s team of algorithm developers, sensor domain experts, and software engineers, to maintain and enhance an established operational system. A successful candidate will be an entry to mid-level computer science graduate with a desire to develop and deploy novel solutions for real mission impact. Candidates should have relevant experience working with modular C/C++ software in a Linux environment (internship or course work is applicable).

 This position involves working as part of multidisciplinary teams to develop, analyze, implement, and test solutions to challenging sensing problems. Strong technical, interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills are desired

 What you will do: 

 
 Work closely with a small, dedicated research team to develop innovative solutions to complex problems

 Support algorithm engineers and scientists to mature advanced algorithms by transforming prototype implementations (Python/MATLAB) into production software (C/C++)

 Maintain and enhance high-quality software for ongoing real world operational users

 Use High-Performance Computing (HPC) Linux environments to build and validate software solutions

 Enhance system quality through software investigations while building domain expertise

 
 Who you are: 

 
 U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a Security Clearance

 BS+ 2 years or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related field

 Intellectually curious and self-driven, with a desire to deliver high-impact technical solutions

 Strong programming skills in C/C++, including pointers and memory management

 Familiar with Python or MATLAB programming languages

 Familiar with source code management (GIT) and Linux development environments

 Team player with excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

 Willing to work full-time onsite (STR Arlington or Woburn)

 
   Even Better: 

 
 Active Secret or Top Secret (TS) clearance

 2+ years of programming experience in C++ (object-oriented, multi-threaded)

 2+ years of programming experience in Python with scientific libraries (numpy, scipy, pandas)

 Solid foundations and interest in scientific computing (mathematics, physics, signal processing

 Familiarity with radar or optical systems data and processing, remote sensing, signal processing

 Familiarity with Linux Bash scripting

 
 Pay Information

 Full-Time Salary Range: $111,000 to $140.000

 The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

  

  

  

 
 STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

 STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

 STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at  www.str.us  for more info.

 
STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at  appassist@str.us  and provide your contact info. 

 Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.
